note: BLM (Malta Field Office) primitive campground in the Little Rocky Mountains just south of Landusky (signed turnoff from US-191/Hwy 66), quiet stream-side setting with lots of shade; no services in Landusky. Access is 3 mi of gravel; sites are shaded/tree-separated and tight. A Campendium reviewer (17-ft Casita) judged the sites best for rigs of about 25 ft or less and the road in rough for big rigs; BLM gives no length. --Claude
